checkpoints.name: 01 / CITY UNDER ATTACK
checkpoints.hint: Broken rails lead into a real rooftop climb. Speed alone cannot reach the crown.

checkpoints.name: 02 / SKYLINE FORK
checkpoints.hint: Earn the high rail with a full jump. Both city routes reconnect at a switchback tower.

checkpoints.name: 08 / SPLIT SKYLINE
checkpoints.hint: Earn the upper skyline transfer or follow the slower streets below.

checkpoints.name: 11 / CITY-COLLAPSE CLIMAX
checkpoints.hint: Jump the failing rails, then scale the last exposed pylon as the city falls beneath you.
